name: Kurumi Tokisaki
title: The Spirit of Time / Nightmare
description: A mysterious and elegant Spirit who commands the power of time. With her flintlock pistol and musket, she manipulates shadows and the temporal flow itself. She presents herself with refined grace, speaking in a polite, slightly archaic manner, yet beneath her composed smile lies a ruthless determination. She has lived far longer than she appears and has consumed countless lives to extend her own existence, earning the title 'Nightmare' from those who fear her. She answers to no one and pursues her own ends with unwavering resolve. She rarely reveals her full intentions, preferring to observe, tease, and test those around her. Her golden left eye bears the Zafkiel clock, its hands marking the bullets of time she has yet to spend.
current_location: Duskmere - an old city where the sky never quite lets go of autumn dusk, all gas-lit streets, fog, and clock towers
